errors.text_span: показва леко спадане до около 19 800 в 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the line shows a slight decrease ("леко спадане") to about 19,800 in 2013. The graph clearly shows an increase from 2012 (approx. 19,500) to 2013 (approx. 20,200). It incorrectly identifies the trend as a decrease and misstates the value for 2013.
